## Problem

What problem does this solve? What's frustrating / inefficient / missing today?

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about, and why did you reject them?

## Use cases

Who benefits? When would they use this?

## Mockups / examples

If you have a sketch, ASCII art, or example output, drop it here.

## Priority

- [ ] Critical (blocks work)
- [ ] High (important but not blocking)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (polish)

## Additional context

Anything else worth mentioning.
